first_R_then_I: R on the first question of each video; I on subsequent questions of that video in the frozen order.
quality_measure: N1-authenticated per-question task_success; outcomes are not used to choose actions or replace samples.
replay_matching: Exact question, arm, input identity, and observed cache state. Unsupported counterfactual states stay unsupported.
cost_basis: Recorded provider tokens times the fixed official Singapore USD list prices dated 2026-09-23; not invoice payment.
vm_allocation: Time-prorated allocation using the pre-build UpCloud price snapshot; report the nine-VM observed interval separately from policy path allocations without adding them twice.
unknown_cost_policy: Retain known subtotals; unknown required components make full totals null and prohibit declaring a full-cost winner.
claim_class: small video-disjoint held-out pilot, not statistical performance or production benchmark
